# Sarathi FinConnect

Sarathi FinConnect is a loan consultancy and financial advisory firm based in Bhavnagar, Gujarat. It helps individuals, professionals, entrepreneurs and businesses explore suitable financing options, prepare applications and coordinate with banks and financial institutions. Sarathi FinConnect is an advisory firm, not a direct lender. Lenders decide eligibility, rates, fees, approval and disbursement.
